title: Lesson 1: Budget Cuts
summary: Let's Learn English returns with Level 2! In this lesson, we meet Anna'a co-workers at The Studio: Anna, Jonathan, Amelia, Kaveh, and Penelope. Rumors of budget cuts travel through the office. But who is going to get fired?
